payload.claim: The refactor intentionally changed the refusal priority in `run_task`: an inline mutant is now checked before the pinned mutants commit's readability, so a spec that both declares a mutant inline and pins an unreadable commit now reports the inline reason instead of the "mutants commit ... is not in the mirror" reason it reported before this change. No test, old or new, constructs a case with both properties together (every existing case in `tests/test_task.py::test_run_task_refuses_an_inline_mutant_or_an_unreadable_mutants_file_before_its_cell` varies only one property at a time). Reintroducing the old standalone `has_commit` check ahead of the `try` block restores the old priority and leaves every test in the suite green, because none of them exercises the combination this reordering was meant to fix.
